title: Persuasion Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in Seaside with access to the Private Beaches at the SAVANNAH pavilion access - 4 houses from the beach access - Walking/biking distance to Seaside, shops and restaurants - Screened in porch and spacious upper roof deck - Bedroom on main level - You will have a total of 8 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker and Keurig - Two adult beach cruiser bikes - 2 Parking Passes - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). Persuasion offers the best of Seaside with beautiful indoor and outdoor spaces including open living room, an updated kitchen, spacious bedrooms, a screened porch with outdoor dining, private balconies and a tower! The QUEEN guest bedroom is on the main level with full bath/shower combo. Upstairs is a KING master bedroom with private balcony and another full bath (shower only). Upstairs one more time is the tower guest bedroom with bunk bed (full on bottom, twin on top, twin trundle) with additional balcony and breathtaking tower water views! A screened porch on the main level offers additional dining and lounging space with UPDATED + EXPANDED outdoor patio and grill space just outside of the porch. 3 Flat Screen TVs - Living Room, Master, and Tower Bedroom (Smart TV). SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 8) 1st floor Bedroom 1: Queen with en-suite bath, tub/shower combo, TV 2nd floor Bedroom 2: King master / attached bathroom (shower only), TV Bedroom 3:Bunk bed with full on bottom, twin on top and twin trundle; separate AC unit, TV Located in the heart of Seaside on Savannah Street, "Persuasion" is an updated 3-bedroom cottage just two streets over from Seaside's town square, only 4 houses up from your private beach access, and a short walk to Seaside's playground, croquet lawn, basketball court, and 2 of the 3 Seaside pools. All in all - a great location! IMPORANT DETAILS * Parking passes for 2 cars * Sorry, no pets allowed ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI Amenities General Hair Dryer Parking Location Type Beach Near The Ocean Safety Outdoor lighting Deadbolt lock on entryway Smoke detectors Carbon monoxide detector Fire extinguisher Health And Safety Enhanced cleaning practices Clean with disinfectant No-contact check-in and check-out High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF Kitchen Full Kitchen Refrigerator Coffee Maker Microwave Toaster Cookware Blender Oven Dishwasher Keurig Coffee Maker Living Air Conditioning Ceiling Fans Linens Washer & Dryer Ironing Board Outdoor Patio Balcony BBQ Grill Shared Pool Tennis Beach Croquet Lawn Playground Tower with Gulf View Water View Screened Porch Entertainment Cable TV WiFi 2 Bikes Included Smart TV Netflx, Amazon, & Hulu+ Beach Town Beach Town - Seaside Special Amenity Special Amenity - Community Pool View View - Tower View Show All Loading Calendar...
